Shift.CloseAndPrint: Close shift and print Z report
Shift.CountHint: Count all cash in the drawer (including the float) and enter the total.
Shift.EndOfDay: End of day: count and close
Shift.EnterCount: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the total.
Shift.EnterCountLbp: Count the Lebanese pounds in the drawer and enter the total (0 if there are none).
Shift.EnterFloat: Enter the opening float (cash in the drawer).
Shift.OpenHint: Count the starting cash (float) in the drawer and enter it below.
Shift.Opened: Shift opened. You can start selling.
